POSE 1 (Top Left): OK. Limbs aligned, balanced stance, feet planted, hands natural, spine straight.
POSE 2 (Top Middle): ISSUE. Floating torso/legs disconnected from ground; limbs lack structural logic.
POSE 3 (Top Right): OK. Dynamic running pose with proper limb counterbalance and foot placement.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): OK. Leaning posture is stable; spine curve matches the lean.
POSE 5 (Bottom Middle): OK. Relaxed standing pose; joints appear functional and grounded.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): ISSUE. Knee joint appears hyperextended or broken; hip connection looks disjointed.
